acceptance: Four independent quarter components verified by mechanical alpha composite at a common ground circle center, with no scaling, rotation, mirroring, color edits, or repainting. The 4-piece assembly preview closes its ring without visible radial gaps.
actual_prompt:
Use this supplied mathematical silhouette image as an EXACT GEOMETRY AND POSITION REFERENCE. Texture its four separate quarter-ring wall pieces into realistic historical Chinese city-builder masonry sprites. Preserve the canvas framing, all four component positions, all exact silhouette boundaries, all radial cut-end positions, each face boundary, relative scale, thickness, curvature, and height. The same fixed orthographic 2:1 dimetric camera is already correctly encoded in the reference. Do not change the camera, reshape the arcs, make taller walls, move the pieces, or enlarge them to fill their cells. This is precision material painting on predesigned component geometry, not a new layout or perspective design.

Four isolated 90-degree slices of a hollow circular wall, in 2 columns by 2 rows. Row major: BACK quarter (negative X,negative Y), RIGHT quarter (positive X,negative Y), LEFT quarter (negative X,positive Y), FRONT quarter (positive X,positive Y). Each is one fourth of the SAME ring with precisely the same world radius and wall height. All vertical edges must stay screen vertical. The broad shallow rear arc is concave facing the viewer; the broad shallow front arc is convex facing the viewer. The tall narrow right and left arcs must remain exactly the same 2:1 camera geometry as the reference. Keep every exposed cut end flat and square, and all top surfaces at the same horizontal world height; end block corners may only chip by 1 or 2 pixels so four pieces can later reconnect without cracks.

Paint high quality finely detailed photorealistic pre-rendered game art: subtle rough material, natural pores, clear masonry courses, aged mortar, small surface wear, neutral daylight from upper left. No black outlines, no flat untextured shapes, no plastic, no toy style. The mathematical reference is ONLY a shape guide: replace its plain flat gray fills completely with the requested realistic masonry surfaces. Keep the transparent background absolutely transparent. No baked ground shadow, no ground, no pedestal, no labels, no diagram, no grid, no text, no extra objects, no complete well or kiln. ONLY these exact four individual quarter-ring wall components. Large clean transparent margins stay exactly as given.

Material:
Medium grey weathered quarried stone, three low staggered courses of fitted rough natural blocks, pale grey mortar, subtle cool grey variation, gently chipped edges, sparse tiny moss flecks. The existing guide wall height is low and MUST remain unchanged. Texture the TOP plane as radial stone blocks. Inner faces naturally darker, outer faces warm grey under upper-left daylight. No water or attachments.
reference_purpose: Original mathematical pose blueprint used only as generation input; never a production sprite. Final pixels are image_gen output.
